description: Offline-authored integration template. Bind fixture identities, verify baseline prerequisites, and explicitly remove template before live use. Each mutation is an independent apply/readback/owned-undo cycle. No live result is claimed.

manual_cases.name: session and build gate

steps.expect: ok=true; readback contains build=454072, version, 64-hex dylib_sha256, session_id, owning library/sequence, modal, writes_enabled, ledger summary.

steps.fixture_action: Repeat against a disposable unsupported build with the default startup policy. Submit edit_request with a new operation_id.
steps.expect: UNSUPPORTED_BUILD, applied=false, unchanged domain readback.

manual_cases.undo_check: No diagnostic read creates an undo entry.

manual_cases.name: independent revision and mismatch

steps.expect: before=after=readback.revision; same session and sequence remain stable across repeated observations.

steps.fixture_action: Send edit_request with operation_id=core-edit-1 and expected_revision=R0.
steps.expect: applied=true, fresh domain readback, R1 differs from R0.
independent result.revision_after equals R1.

steps.fixture_action: Send a different operation_id with stale expected_revision=R0.
steps.expect: REVISION_MISMATCH, applied=false, native state and undo stack unchanged.

steps.fixture_action: Make a human edit and re-read revision.
steps.expect: revision changes; old expected_revision fails without mutation.

manual_cases.undo_check: Use v4.history.undo on core-edit-1 only before any human edit; check baseline domain state independently.

manual_cases.name: checkpoint is observational

steps.expect: fresh owning sequence, revision and undo top are returned.

steps.fixture_action: Repeat checkpoint without changing the host.
steps.expect: revision and undo top remain unchanged; no synthetic undo action is added.

manual_cases.undo_check: Checkpoint itself has no undo group.

manual_cases.name: deadline, status, idempotency, and single writer

steps.fixture_action: Submit a controlled slow native edit with operation_id=core-slow-1.
steps.expect: At 20s the client receives status=pending, operation_id=core-slow-1, applied=null.
Responds without waiting for the main thread. readback.state is QUEUED/RUNNING until settlement.

steps.fixture_action: Concurrently submit the same ID+params from another connection, then a distinct edit.
steps.expect: The first edit applies once. The second edit starts only after the first native handler has really completed.
Eventually COMPLETED/FAILED/UNKNOWN, with the exact stored result. Independent native readback matches a completed result.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and no new native edit.

manual_cases.undo_check: Exactly one top named group for a successful undoable slow edit; undo returns to the recorded baseline.

manual_cases.name: restart and conservative reconciliation

steps.fixture_action: In a disposable fixture, restart after reserving/starting a controlled slow edit. Save its ID and raw journal before restart.
steps.expect: Queued/running journal entries become UNKNOWN; never replay them automatically.
readback.state=UNKNOWN; recovered historical session is visible.
Fresh native state is returned; state remains UNKNOWN and reexecuted=false.

steps.fixture_action: Obtain domain-native/XML evidence and fresh v4 revision. Send resolution=applied or not_applied, evidence=<measured fields>, expected_revision=<fresh token>.
steps.expect: RECONCILED only with explicit evidence; warning says client attestation. No native edit runs.

steps.fixture_action: Request undo for a pre-restart operation.
steps.expect: UNDO_NOT_OWNED; no other native group is touched.

manual_cases.undo_check: Native ownership never survives FCP restart, even when a historical result survives.

manual_cases.name: owned undo and protected human history

steps.fixture_action: Capture baseline and apply an undoable domain edit, operation_id=core-owned-1.
steps.expect: undo.kind=native_group with a unique label; verify fresh native state.
applied=true; independent domain readback equals baseline.
Exact cached result; no second undo.

steps.fixture_action: Apply another edit and make a human edit above its group. Request v4 undo for the earlier operation.
steps.expect: UNDO_NOT_TOP; human edit and undo top remain intact.

manual_cases.undo_check: Verify full native target values/structure after undo; do not treat action name or group creation as baseline proof.

manual_cases.name: modal safety across reads and writes

steps.fixture_action: Open a disposable sheet/dialog with a recognizable title, including the legacy video-properties dialog if reproducible.
steps.expect: Record visible title before issuing RPCs.
MODAL_PRESENT, applied=false, readback.modal.title matches; dialog remains open.

steps.fixture_action: Issue a domain read that delegates to legacy RPCs, then a domain mutation.
steps.expect: Neither dismisses the dialog; mutation returns MODAL_PRESENT without applying.
Diagnostic result includes modal.present=true and title without dismissal.

steps.fixture_action: Close the dialog explicitly as a human, then obtain a fresh revision.
steps.expect: Normal native readback works again.

manual_cases.undo_check: No rejected request adds or consumes an undo group.

fixture_setup: Open exactly the disposable 30fps fixture library/project; no production library may be open.

The trimmed main AV clip starts at component-local 300/30s. Preinstall two Gaussian instances A/B in the same section (B after A), Letterbox and Colorize; discover every native parameter path and enum value.
Use a present intrinsic scale channel with two baseline keys at 360/30s and 390/30s, with the first outgoing segment S-curve. Use a different unkeyed Amount sample at 330/30s.

Preinstall an editable title with field 0 text Hello world, an English caption with block 0, an existing Turkish role and Music audio role, and a transition on a SECOND cut. The main left/right cut must be transition-free with sufficient handles.
Baseline gain is unanimated, fades are absent, channels enabled, role is not Music, and rate is 1x. Verify custom generator identity and all fixtures before removing template.
Repeated native XML exports must be exact except security-scoped bookmark bytes. Preserve raw XML; explicitly compare asset src, duration and format ID; any other instability stops testing.
Keep complete FCPXML before/after/undo and separate native frame/audio/save-reopen evidence. Scope here is readback/undo only.
